name: Zoom
summary: Ray-casting that lets the user magnify the area under the cursor until the target is large enough to select.
howItWorks: The user points a ray at a region and zooms in on it continuously; as the view magnifies, nearby objects spread apart until the intended one can be picked with an ordinary ray.

relationships.note: ARM uses zooming as a refinement step.

review.notes: Added from Weise, Zender & Lucke 2019 (Oct 2026). Attributes drafted by Claude from the survey descriptions and the original paper's abstract; not yet checked against the paper.
